data.title: 雷电将军 · 书斋墨夜
data.description: 【成年雷电将军 · 书斋墨夜】深夜天守阁书斋只余纸灯，二十岁以上成年版本的影独自侧倚软垫，轻薄紫色里衣从肩头滑到腰际，裸露胸线与成熟腰腹。她屈起一腿压住散开的古卷，一手支撑身体，另一手在半掩衣摆下缓慢抚慰自己；电光沿长辫与墨迹游走，她咬唇看向镜头，任呼吸扰乱一贯平静。
data.action: 独自侧倚书斋软垫，里衣滑至腰际，一手撑身、一手探入衣摆自抚，紫电沿长辫与古卷游走
data.lighting: warm paper lantern light and soft shadows
data.promptProse: Paper lanterns illuminate adult, age-twenty-plus Raiden Ei alone in the Tenshukaku study after midnight. She reclines sideways across floor cushions with a thin violet under-robe open to the waist, exposing bare breasts and a mature abdomen. One bent leg pins scattered decrees while one hand braces behind her and the other moves beneath the loosened hem between her thighs. Small Electro arcs travel along her long braid and wet ink as violet eyes soften behind a bitten lip. Horizontal intimate portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Along the near cushion edge, a decree scroll and closed inkstone sit on a low wooden desk. Paper lanterns above the left side illuminate the scroll ribs and desk lip, casting diagonal brush-holder shadows across the floorboards. Shelves of bound documents recede into the study's midnight shade. Raiden Ei is an adult woman, age twenty or older.
